summary: The 11-17 menu has 49 names. Every one has fscore_computable 9, so no score depends on missing tests, and only GRMN and ONC carry a pre-computed flag (an amended filing). My top picks are VRSN (F9, gp_sector_pct 0.993, CFO above net income, lowest volatility among the high-ranked names), DPZ and CARG (both top of sector), with TPR and AAPL the best names not already held. All 12 held single names are still on the menu, so the MCO and EXEL 'drops off the menu' clauses have not tripped. The clearest accounting concern is DORM, where operating cash flow is about half of net income. Learning file: no lesson names the Fundamentals Analyst and I have no graded calls, so nothing there changed my ranking. L3's label caveat (written for the proposer and PM) is why I flag sector labels below.
